messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High error rate detected on ingress-apigw (502/504) across edge pool eu-west-1a. Current 5m error rate: 11.8% (>alert threshold 5%). Pager link: https://pager.redwood/INC-17742 :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: grabbing pager. any customer-facing P0 pages yet?

carla_sre: seeing spike correlate with increased POST volume to /v1/generate from several clients, request latencies from edge->origin spiking, upstream returns 502s.

ben_platform: checking routing table and recent deploys — no code deploys in last 40m. config rollout to edge mux was started 12m ago (canary).

alice_oncall: can we pause the mux rollout? if that's the common factor, rollback asap.

ben_platform: pausing rollout now. command: `./opsctl rollout pause --id mux-config-2026-03-17-12`

frank_network: telemetry shows connection pool exhaustion on edge-proxy instances in eu-west-1a. SYN backlog approaching 90%.

carla_sre: initiating circuit-break: reduce upstream concurrency for that pool from 200->50. Applying temporary rate-limit to clients with >100 rps.

alice_oncall: dave_support — any elevated tickets? we should notify top 5 SSO customers.

dave_support: support triage: ACME & BetaCorp show ~20% generation failures. Opening outreach threads. Draft: "We're aware of an elevated error rate impacting generation APIs in eu-west; working on mitigation; will update in 15m."

eva_product: flagging critical SLAs for BetaCorp (SLA window ongoing). advise to add them to status page.

ben_platform: rolling traffic away from eu-west-1a to eu-west-1b/c as a temporary shift. command: `traffic-shift --from eu-west-1a --to eu-west-1b,eu-west-1c --percent 100 --dry=false`

incident-bot: Automated action: traffic shift initiated by ben_platform at 1774220400. Estimated completion 60s per region.

carla_sre: after shift, error rate dropped to 3.1% overall, eu-west-1a still showing 18% but traffic there is <5% now. CPU on eu-west-1a edge-proxies at 96%.

frank_network: looks like a memory leak on the proxy process; restarted 3/6 proxies in eu-west-1a and metrics recovered on those nodes. Suggest draining remaining and reprovisioning.

alice_oncall: agree. start drain + scale up new proxies in that AZ. ben, can we spin new instances with patched kernel settings?

ben_platform: launching 4 new edge-proxies in eu-west-1a with increased process rlimits. `infractl scale --pool edge-proxy-eu-west-1a --add 4 --ami edge-proxy-v3b`

carla_sre: note: KV-cache hit ratio dropped during spike — small perf regression for cached prefixes, may explain some upstream pressure. follow-up: verify cache warming.

alice_oncall: customer impact summary (preliminary): ~12% of generation requests returned 502/504 for customers routed through eu-west-1a between 1774219940-1774220500. Top impacted customers: ACME, BetaCorp, GammaApp. Support is sending hotfix update.

dave_support: outreach sent to ACME & BetaCorp. ACME responded: "we see timeouts on our test harness, rotating to other regions fixed it for us."

eva_product: marking incident as Sev2 for now, escalate to Sev1 if errors persist >30m or customer impact widens.

carla_sre: temp mitigations applied: paused mux rollout, traffic shift, drained + restarted proxies, concurrency CB. All together brought error rate under threshold.

frank_network: capturing packet drops + socket stats for 6 affected machines; will upload pcap/logs to /shared/incidents/1774219999/ for postmortem.

ben_platform: keeping canary paused. root cause suspected: new mux config interacting poorly with older edge-proxy kernel on high RPS POST paths -> connection backlog + upstream 502s.

alice_oncall: next steps: (1) restore normal traffic gradually (2) repro in staging with mux config + older kernel (3) ensure all edge-proxies on latest ami (4) postmortem within 48h. I'll handoff to night oncall once error rate stable for 30m.

incident-bot: Note: on-call handoff scheduled at 1774223800 to user `gina_oncall`.

carla_sre: one more thing — add synthetic probes for high-rate POST flows per AZ to detect similar regressions earlier.

alice_oncall: +1. also bump alert sensitivity for ingress-apigw to 3% in combination with CPU >85% on edge-proxy to reduce noisy fires.

frank_network: uploaded pcaps and sockstat dumps to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/1774219999/pcaps.tar.gz

ben_platform: re-enable traffic to eu-west-1a at 10% and monitor.

carla_sre: monitoring: 5m err rate now 1.8%, p99 latency back to baseline. closing immediate bridge in 10m if stable.

alice_oncall: handing off to night: errors stabilized, mitigations in place, follow-up runbook items assigned. If rate creeps above 5% again ping me and escalate.

gina_oncall: acknowledged handoff (not in thread participants, will join post-handoff).

dave_support: final note: support tickets for BetaCorp & ACME updated with post-fix ETA and status page updated.

alice_oncall: thanks everyone. formal postmortem owner: carla_sre. I'll file the incident stub now.

carla_sre: created postmortem stub: https://pm.redwood/INC-1774219999/postmortem — assigned RCA and timeline.

alice_oncall: closing bridge. last check-in timestamp: 1774222305.

incident-bot: Incident bridge closed by alice_oncall at 1774222305.
